# Speed With Style

> Speed With Style is a learn-to-swim school for kids in Bateman, Perth, Western Australia, running since 2019 with more than 1,200 swimmers. Lessons are at Corpus Christi College Aquatic Centre (Jennifer Reilly Aquatic Centre), 50 Murdoch Dr, Bateman WA 6150. Classes have a maximum of four children, guaranteed. Learn-to-swim lessons are 30 minutes in a heated 33°C pool and cost $28 ($26 for Corpus Christi College families). Children usually start from age 4 and progress through one pathway: Learn to Swim, Pre-Squad, then Squad, with no level system. Every instructor is a current or former squad swimmer. The program was designed by Head Coach and founder John (JJ) Williams with Dr. Nigel Williams, a child and adolescent behaviour specialist. Book a free lesson on the website, call 0409 898 232 or email admin@speedwithstyle.com.au.

- [Home](https://www.speedwithstyle.com.au/): programs, pricing, parent reviews, FAQ, location and booking.
- [Meet the team](https://www.speedwithstyle.com.au/about/): founders, pool deck managers and every instructor, with their swimming backgrounds.
- [Our values](https://www.speedwithstyle.com.au/values/): technique first, four per class, process over pressure, and why there is no level system.
- [What to expect](https://www.speedwithstyle.com.au/what-to-expect/): parking, directions, photos of the centre, what to bring, and how the first session runs.
